import sys,numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'source'); import mdtraj as md
from mdtraj.core import element
# six-member ring crossing x boundary; all atoms in a valid whole geometry
T=md.Topology(); c=T.add_chain(); r=T.add_residue('RNG',c); ats=[T.add_atom(str(i),element.carbon,r) for i in range(6)]
for i in range(6): T.add_bond(ats[i],ats[(i+1)%6])
angles=np.arange(6)*np.pi/3
whole=np.c_[.5+.18*np.cos(angles),.5+.18*np.sin(angles),np.zeros(6)+.5].astype(np.float32)
# translate so ring crosses boundary, wrap all atoms
whole[:,0]+=0.45; wrapped=whole.copy(); wrapped[:,:2]%=1
tr=md.Trajectory(wrapped[None],T); tr.unitcell_vectors=np.eye(3,dtype=np.float32)[None]; out=tr.make_molecules_whole()
orig=np.array([np.linalg.norm(whole[i]-whole[(i+1)%6]) for i in range(6)])
new=np.array([np.linalg.norm(out.xyz[0,i]-out.xyz[0,(i+1)%6]) for i in range(6)])
print(orig,new,'max err',np.max(np.abs(orig-new))); assert np.max(np.abs(orig-new))<2e-6
